metadata.llm_reason: Candidate 'Test Dependency Declaration' is a distinct micro_skill addressing test execution sequencing via pytest markers. It differs semantically from peer candidates (HTTP recording, filesystem mocking, HTTP request mocking) which focus on test isolation, and from existing skills which address infrastructure migration and thread initialization. The skill has support evidence and no conflicts. It introduces a new capability for enforcing test prerequisites and should be persisted as a new asset.
